program.name: Campus Learning Demo School — Mathematics Pathway
program.pathway: Grade 3 CCSS Math foundations → Grade 7 core Math (+ optional Science)
program.summary: Synthetic demo catalog covering Grade 3 Common Core Mathematics plus Grade 7 Mathematics and Science.

semesters.name: Grade 3 Common Core Mathematics
semesters.theme: Scope & sequence (CCSS) — from curriculum document seed

modules.title: Unit 1: Numbers and Operations in Base Ten
modules.description: Place value to 1,000; rounding; addition and subtraction within 1,000; mental math strategies.

modules.title: Unit 2: Operations — Multiplication and Division
modules.description: Meaning of multiplication; facts 2–10; division as equal groups and arrays.

modules.title: Unit 3: Fractions
modules.description: Fractions as parts of a whole; number line; comparing and equivalent fractions.

modules.title: Unit 4: Geometry
modules.description: Attributes of 2D shapes; perimeter and area; partitioning shapes into equal parts.

modules.title: Unit 5: Measurement and Data
modules.description: Time to the minute; length in cm/m; mass and volume; bar graphs and pictographs.

semesters.name: Grade 7 Mathematics
semesters.theme: Core school course (c0000000-…010) — algebra, geometry, statistics

modules.title: Rational Numbers & Proportional Reasoning
modules.description: Integers, rational numbers, ratios, rates, and proportional relationships.

modules.title: Expressions & Equations
modules.description: Simplifying expressions, solving one- and two-step equations, inequalities.

modules.title: Geometry — Angles, Triangles & Scale Drawings
modules.description: Angle relationships, triangle conditions, scale drawings, and area/volume applications.

modules.title: Statistics & Probability
modules.description: Sampling, measures of center/variability, and basic probability models.

semesters.name: Grade 7 Science
semesters.theme: Core school course (c0000000-…011) — biology, chemistry basics, physics

modules.title: Living Systems & Cells
modules.description: Cell structure, organization of living systems, and basic life processes.

modules.title: Matter & Chemical Changes
modules.description: States of matter, mixtures, and introductory chemical change vs physical change.

modules.title: Forces, Motion & Energy
modules.description: Forces, simple machines, kinetic/potential energy, and heat transfer basics.

pathways.name: Grade 3 CCSS Math track
pathways.focus: Numbers & operations → multiplication/division → fractions → geometry → measurement & data.

requirements: Stay enrolled in at least one active teaching section.
Complete unit assessments before advancing when sequential gating is enabled.
Maintain good academic standing; at-risk learners may receive reteach / practice assignments from instructors.
